mg.title: Light on my feet

text.main: I feel rejuvenated and, like, light on my feet.

mg.use: Over Anaya as she says it, after the hook text goes off. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Lace them up

text.main: they feel amazing, I can't wait to lace them up

mg.use: Over his face as he says it, after the sneaker shot. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Frame the sneaker
mg.use: Frames the sneaker he holds up to the lens. Move it to where the shoe sits.

mg.title: Wipe to the shoes
mg.use: Cut into Jasmine's shoe shot at the middle of the wipe. Use it once.

mg.title: Where she wears them
mg.use: Each line lands on her word. Drop it if you drop this bite.

mg.title: Can't wait

text.main: I just can't wait to put them on.

mg.use: Short full-frame cutaway on his line, then back to him in the lens.

note: The plan for this cut leaves room for only 8 graphics.
